title: DISCO Earns 7 G2 Fall 2026 Badges in Ediscovery
summary: G2’s Fall 2026 report recognized DISCO with 7 badges in Ediscovery, including Leader, Momentum, and Best ROI.
body_markdown:
We're proud to share that DISCO has been recognized with **seven badges in G2's Fall 2026 Reports** in the Ediscovery category.


Awards are an honor, but what matters most is where these badges come from: the attorneys, litigation support professionals, and case teams who use DISCO on high-stakes matters every day. In litigation, the stakes are too high for "good enough." These reviews tell us DISCO is helping teams know their facts faster, work with confidence, and get to the real work of the case.


**Our thanks go to every customer who took the time to share feedback, and to the DISCO team, who design, build, and operate our platform and services with the same care you bring to your clients.**[Leave us feedback on G2](https://www.g2.com/products/disco-disco-platform/reviews) .


### **DISCO's G2 Fall 2026 badges**


Here's what each badge recognizes and what it reflects about working with DISCO.


#### **Leader**


**What it means:** Products in the Leader quadrant of G2's Grid® Report are rated highly by G2 users and have substantial Satisfaction and Market Presence scores.


This badge reflects the whole picture. Most ediscovery providers see themselves as either a software company or a services company. DISCO is both, and our groundbreaking legal AI is at the core of each.[For more than a decade](https://csdisco.com/blog/disco-ai-lab-10-years) , we've built AI for and with attorneys, shaped by the demands of high-stakes litigation. We design, build, and operate our own AI-native platform and the services that bring it to life. That means fewer handoffs, faster insight, and total accountability from one team that knows your work as well as its own. We’re proud to be with you in every case.


#### **Momentum Leader**


**What it means:** Products in the Leader tier of G2's Momentum Grid® rank in the top 25% of their category's products by user feedback.


Momentum reflects where a product is headed, and DISCO is moving fast. With the launch of[Cecilia Advanced Research](https://csdisco.com/agentic-cecilia-ai) , our agentic AI capability for discovery, DISCO helps case teams gain a strategic advantage from day one. We’ve also made massive strides this year in the arena of AI-powered document review, with our new[Tag Tuner capability](https://csdisco.com/blog/tag-tuner-transforms-genai-document-review) for[Auto Review](https://csdisco.com/offerings/auto-review) putting AI-powered review directly into the command of our clients for the first time. And, as our Chief Product, Technology, and Strategy Officer[Richard Crum shared earlier](https://csdisco.com/blog/when-good-isnt-enough-why-litigators-need-a-purpose-built-platform) this year, we’re coming to market with a new solution that brings facts and law together – modeled on the way lawyers work to revolutionize the way legal technology works.


#### **Leader Mid-Market**


**What it means:** Products in the Leader quadrant of G2's Mid-Market Grid® Report are rated highly by G2 users and have substantial Satisfaction and Market Presence scores.


Mid-sized firms compete for complex matters and can't afford missed documents or blown deadlines. DISCO is designed for large-scale, complex cases, but simple to master. It scales automatically from 10 documents to 10 million, with sub-second search and document load, and is built for intuitive use.


#### **Best Estimated ROI Mid-Market**


**What it means:** The Best Estimated ROI product in G2's Results Index earned the best estimated ROI rating in its category. The rating combines estimated time to achieve ROI and time to go live.


Firms measure ROI in the advantages they gain: how early they find the key documents and identify evidentiary gaps, and how quickly they can build themes and zero in on witnesses. The sooner your team has command of the facts, the stronger your position in every meet-and-confer, negotiation, and strategy session. DISCO puts that command within reach from day one.


💡 **Pro tip:** Speed to value also depends on getting up and running without disruption.[DISCO's Professional Services](https://csdisco.com/offerings/professional-services) bench of former litigators, review managers, and data specialists absorbs the transition, so your team can stay focused on the case.


#### **Easiest Admin Mid-Market**


**What it means:** The Easiest Admin product in G2's Usability Index earned the highest Ease of Admin rating in its category.


Litigation support teams keep complex matters running. DISCO gives them real admin control in a platform that scales automatically for millions of documents and hundreds of users with no manual intervention. That means less time maintaining infrastructure or chasing vendors, and more time supporting the case team.


#### **Leader Small-Business**


**What it means:** Products in the Leader quadrant of G2's Small-Business Grid® Report are rated highly by G2 users and have substantial Satisfaction and Market Presence scores.


Boutique litigation firms take on high-stakes cases with lean teams. For them, the more complex the case, the bigger the advantage DISCO provides.[Cecilia AI](https://csdisco.com/offerings/cecilia) ,[Timelines](https://csdisco.com/offerings/timelines) , and[Deposition Management](https://csdisco.com/offerings/case-builder) give a small team the reach of a much larger one, all in a single source of truth.


#### **High Performer Enterprise**


**What it means:** Products in the High Performer quadrant of G2's Enterprise Grid® Report have high customer Satisfaction scores and low Market Presence scores compared with the rest of the category.


Legal departments in large organizations hold ediscovery technology to a high bar for security, defensibility, and performance at scale. This badge reflects strong satisfaction among enterprise users, backed by DISCO's cloud-native architecture on AWS and SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA certifications.


### **What these badges mean for your case team**


For years, ediscovery ran on a simple equation: more data meant more reviewers and longer timelines. Most firms accepted it because there wasn't a better option.


These badges are a sign that the equation has changed. Firms using DISCO are getting to the facts faster, with fewer handoffs and more confidence in what they find. Their clients are noticing. When the next RFP asks how your firm is using AI to deliver better outcomes, "the way we've always done it" won't be a strong answer.


Taken together, these seven badges show what DISCO customers are experiencing:


- **One accountable partner** that designs, builds, and operates both the platform and the services.
- **Fast, powerful, cutting-edge legal technology** that scales with your hardest cases.
- **Innovation and expertise that move cases forward** and puts you in command of your facts from the very outset of the matter.


As one customer put it: *“I’ve used almost every ediscovery solution on the market and DISCO is by far the best at handling large, complex cases."* — Jessica Wehby, Director of e-Discovery Support, Lightfoot


### **See how DISCO gives you command of your facts**


No matter how large or complex your matter, DISCO is with you in every case:


- Get answers from your documents in plain English with Cecilia Advanced Research
- Search and load documents in under a second, from 10 documents to 10 million
- Choose your support model: self-manage, co-manage, or hand off an entire matter


[Schedule a demo](https://csdisco.com/schedule-demo) to see why case teams rate DISCO a Leader.
